purpose: Defensive evidence map separating internet shutdown behavior from targeted digital repression and RF/GNSS interference during protest periods.

network_structure.summary: Freedom House reports Serbia has no past record of internet shutdowns amid elections or national events; ISP infrastructure is not centralized, Serbian Open eXchange is private/decentralized, though state-owned Telekom Serbia is the largest operator.
network_structure.implication: Serbia is a strong negative control against any simple theory that large anti-government protests automatically produce national internet shutdowns.

protest_windows.internet_effect: No established shutdown pattern; online mobilization remained available.

protest_windows.event: Nationwide student-led anti-corruption protest wave after Novi Sad station canopy collapse
protest_windows.internet_effect: No confirmed broad internet shutdown despite extremely large and persistent demonstrations.
protest_windows.digital_repression: Detentions over protest-related online content, confiscation/search of phones, spyware targeting, harassment of online journalists and activists.

protest_windows.internet_effect: A public rumor claimed all communications networks would be shut off at 16:00, but no credible evidence of a citywide/nationwide internet shutdown was found in the reviewed sources; major live coverage and online reporting continued.
protest_windows.rf_gnss_effect: BIRN reported GPS jamming and spoofing in the Belgrade area between approximately 13:00 and 17:00, supported by GPSWise/GPSJam data and reports from pilots; later reporting described drone losses/spoofing at protest events.
protest_windows.attribution_ceiling: GNSS interference is technically corroborated at the signal level; actor attribution and intent remain unproven in this artifact. It must not be merged with DPI/TSPU evidence.

technology_and_surveillance.scope: Device compromise, extraction and surveillance of activists/journalists; not network shutdown or DPI censorship.
Chinese technology relationship and surveillance concerns; not Russian SORM/TSPU lineage.

2026_watch.signal: OONI-derived middlebox-detection anomaly (http_invalid_request_line), 1 record / very small sample.
IODA-derived regional connectivity disruptions in several Serbian districts.

negative_controls_and_corrections: Large protests in Serbia repeatedly occurred without confirmed national internet shutdowns.
A rumor of an imminent network shutdown on 2025-03-15 is not evidence that a shutdown occurred.
GNSS jamming/spoofing is a different technical layer from DPI, routing manipulation, DNS filtering or TSPU-like control.
Targeted spyware/device extraction is digital repression but must not be counted as path-level network filtering.
Chinese telecom/surveillance relationships do not support Russian control-plane attribution.

next_required_evidence: Independent ASN/operator-localized OONI or IODA evidence during a protest window.
Matched alternate-network controls showing path-specific interference.
Direct RF attribution or official technical records for GNSS jamming/spoofing if cross-domain resilience is evaluated.
Any documented Russian-origin network-control equipment must be proven separately; none is established here.
